sheets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent painterly game item sprite sheet
Primary request: Paint 16 distinct isolated object sprites for the Lantern Atlas near-isometric RPG in an exact 4 by 4 regular grid. Canvas 2048 by 2048 pixels. Each cell is 512 by 512 pixels; one named subject per cell, read left to right then top to bottom.
Style/medium: detailed hand-painted storybook gouache and oil, softly textured materials, warm brass, cream ceramics, muted forest green, matching the existing café and supermarket interior object sheets. Three-quarter view, consistent top-left warm lighting.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent alpha, no painted backdrop.
Composition: one complete object centred in each cell, maximum object extent 380 pixels, generous transparent margins of at least 60 pixels, no overlap between cells, no cast shadows outside the object. Keep small details legible at 128 pixels.
Subjects in row-major order:
1. one friendly brown dog sitting
2. one grey cat sitting
3. one brown horse standing
4. one pink pig standing
5. one small brown sparrow perched
6. one brown and white cow standing
7. one plain red rubber ball
8. one black and white football
9. one wooden acoustic guitar
10. one upright brown piano
11. one small green camping tent
12. one wrapped cream gift box tied with red ribbon
13. one gold finger ring
14. one gold necklace
15. one green canvas shoulder bag
16. one small sepia photograph showing a harbour in a paper frame
Constraints: exactly 16 objects, correct subject ordering, no labels, no legible text, no grid lines, no watermark, no emoji, no vector line icons. Transparent background; retain native alpha. Each silhouette must be identifiable without a written label.
